description: First-ever execution test of TXLEGACY's own internal CLONEDIR-reading logic (tools/qclsrc/txlegacy.clp), which every part05-legacy-probe/part05-gen-probe connection has bypassed so far by compiling the same target objects directly via 'file'/'cl' manifest steps instead of actually CALLing TXLEGACY. TXLEGACY reads 9 files via its own CPYFRMSTMF calls (LOADPF/LOADDSPF/LOADRPG/LOADCLP subroutines), each hardcoding STMFCCSID(1208) - matching what a real learner's real `git clone` produces (per 05-01's own manually-typed CPYFRMSTMF commands, also STMFCCSID(1208)), but NOT matching this harness's own heredoc-based 'file' steps for every other manifest so far (which deliberately omit STMFCCSID, per harness-selftest's CCSID finding: heredoc'd files are genuinely CCSID 273/EBCDIC-tagged-and-encoded, and forcing a false 1208 tag on real-273 content corrupts CPYFRMSTMF, CPC7305->CPC7309/CPFA0A2/CPFA095). This manifest deliberately does NOT try to preemptively fix that potential mismatch (e.g. via CHGJOB CCSID before writing) - it is a genuine diagnostic connection, matching this repo's own established practice of testing the straightforward approach first and deciding the real fix from real results, not from speculation. Uses the new 'file' step 'remotePath' field (verify/lib/batch.mjs, 2026-09-27) to place the 9 tree files at the exact $HOME-relative paths TXLEGACY's own CPYFRMSTMF calls expect (src/legacy/qddssrc|qrpgsrc|qclsrc/*), instead of the flattened vfy/<batch>/basename path every other manifest step uses - these files are placed on the IFS only (remoteSrcFile/member omitted, so no CPYFRMSTMF-into-a-member happens for them; TXLEGACY's own internal logic does that itself, at runtime, which is exactly the mechanism under test). Debug CCSID output is enabled on the first tree file (fldref.pf) to observe the actual tag/bytes regardless of whether TXLEGACY itself succeeds. Prerequisite: TXSETUP has already built the sample DB (TOKUIM/JUCHUM/JUCHUD/ZAIKOM/TANTOM) in this library - same prerequisite as every other part05-* manifest, already satisfied from earlier connections in this library. TXLEGACY is called WITHOUT FORCE(*YES) (TXLEGST does not yet exist in this library since TXLEGACY itself has never been CALLed here before - this is a genuine first-time-load test, not a forced rebuild, and avoids exercising the FORCE(*YES)/SAVF-backup path in the same connection). If this connection shows the STMFCCSID(1208)-on-273-content corruption, the fix is either (a) CHGJOB CCSID(1208) before writing the tree files in a follow-up manifest (requires reordering batch.mjs's fixed file->sh->cl group order so 'sh' can run before 'file', not yet implemented), or (b) discovering CPYFRMSTMF's STMFCCSID(1208) on a genuinely-273-tagged file behaves differently than harness-selftest's own case for some other reason - do not assume either without connecting first.

steps.label: CPTXLEGCMD
steps.cmd: CRTCMD CMD(&LIB/TXLEGACY) PGM(*LIBL/TXLEGACY) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCMDSRC) SRCMBR(TXLEGACY) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFYOBJ2 WHERE ODOBNM IN ('TK0100', 'JU0300', 'ZA0500', 'JU0900C', 'MN0000C') FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
